_comment: Single source of truth for resume templates. Consumed by the client preview (client/src/config/templates.js) AND the server PDF/DOCX renderers (server/src/templateRegistry.js). Each template maps to a layout 'archetype' that both renderers implement identically. Do not duplicate this data elsewhere.

archetypes.classic-centered: Centered name/title header, single column, full-width section rules.
archetypes.formal-left: Left-aligned serif header, dense single column for academic/consulting.
archetypes.header-band: Full-width colored header band with reversed-out name, single column below.
archetypes.sidebar: Two-column layout with a colored sidebar carrying contact, skills and languages.
archetypes.compact: Dense single column with smaller type and two-column skills to fit more content.
archetypes.infographic: Single column with visual skill-rating bars and accent blocks.

templates.name: Modern
